b2-28-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Fitting In
b2-28-01.scenario: On the terrace in Posillipo, Lola asks you how a Hungarian family that came to Naples a year ago is doing.
b2-28-01.prompt: Tell her the family fitted into the local community quickly.
b2-28-01.target: A család gyorsan beilleszkedett a helyi közösségbe.
b2-28-01.english: The family quickly fitted into the local community.
b2-28-01.canDo: I can use figurative preverbs like beilleszkedik and elidegenedik to describe social integration and alienation

b2-28-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Leaving and Moving Away
b2-28-02.scenario: Márai Sándor asks you what the young people from the eastern villages did after the war.
b2-28-02.prompt: Tell him what some did and what others did.
b2-28-02.target: Sokan kivándoroltak, mások csak a fővárosba vándoroltak el.
b2-28-02.english: Many emigrated, others only moved away to the capital.
b2-28-02.canDo: I can use kivándorol for leaving a country and elvándorol for moving away from a place

b2-28-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Across the Border
b2-28-03.scenario: Márai Sándor asks you how a writer friend got out of the country and where he stayed.
b2-28-03.prompt: Tell him the writer crossed the border and settled in Naples.
cues: Say that he crossed the border
b2-28-03.target: Az író átlépte a határt, és Nápolyban telepedett le.
b2-28-03.english: The writer crossed the border and settled in Naples.
b2-28-03.canDo: I can tell how someone crossed a border and settled abroad (átlépte, letelepedett)

b2-28-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Year Abroad
b2-28-04.scenario: Lola asks you what brain drain is and how a researcher's knowledge can still come home.
b2-28-04.prompt: Tell her what brain drain is and what brings the knowledge back.
cues: Say what brings the knowledge home
b2-28-04.target: A jól képzett emberek külföldre mennek: ez az agyelszívás. A tudástranszfer hazahozza a tudásukat.
b2-28-04.english: Well-trained people go abroad: that is brain drain. Knowledge transfer brings their knowledge home.
b2-28-04.canDo: I can explain agyelszívás and tudástranszfer in simple sentences

b2-28-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Sending and Host Countries
b2-28-05.scenario: Márai Sándor asks you what happens to the young people who leave one country for another.
b2-28-05.prompt: Tell him where they leave from and what the other country gives them.
cues: Say what the country they leave is called
Say what the new country gives them
b2-28-05.target: A kibocsátó országból sok fiatal elmegy, a fogadó ország pedig munkát ad nekik.
b2-28-05.english: Many young people leave the sending country, and the host country gives them work.
b2-28-05.canDo: I can contrast sending countries (kibocsátó ország) and host countries (fogadó ország)

b2-28-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What Became of the Emigrants
b2-28-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the evening in Posillipo, Lola asks you what happened to the Hungarians who emigrated.
b2-28-consolidation.prompt: Tell her that many fitted into the new country, but some became alienated from their homeland.
cues: Say what many did in the new country
Say what some did to their homeland
b2-28-consolidation.target: Sokan beilleszkedtek az új országban, de egyesek elidegenedtek a szülőföldjüktől.
b2-28-consolidation.english: Many fitted into the new country, but some became alienated from their homeland.
b2-28-consolidation.canDo: I can use beilleszkedik, elidegenedik and gyökeret ver about people who live abroad
